text: 55 1. Listen, repeat and read. 2. Listen and write. Moral : Work hard today for a better tomorrow. An ant and a grasshopper were good friends. During summer, the ant worked hard to collect food. While the grasshopper enjoyed the sunny weather. It played all day and collected no food. When winter arrived, the ant was resting. It was eating the food gathered during summer. The hungry grasshopper asked the ant for some food. The ant gave it some. The next day, the grasshopper again asked the ant for food. The ant replied, ‘‘I am sorry, my dear friend. This food is just enough for my family. We all worked hard the whole summer to gather food. You enjoyed the summer time. You did not save any food for the cold winter. We cannot share food with you now.’’ grasshopper summer share hard during arrived collect winter hungry gathered resting enough The Ant and the Grasshopper 3.9 Do you know? • The names of insects.
